Data.Title: <%%>ScDemo.Northwind.Category._EntityName
Data.EntityComment: Stores product categories used to group related products. Each category can have a name, description, and optional picture. It is referenced by products.

Data.Title: <%%>ScDemo.Northwind.Customer._EntityName
Data.EntityComment: Stores customer master data such as company name and contact details. Customers can place orders and can be linked to demographic classifications. This entity represents the central customer record.

Data.Title: <%%>ScDemo.Northwind.CustomerCustomerDemo._EntityName
Data.EntityComment: Associative entity that maps customers to customer demographic categories. It is used to represent the many-to-many relationship between customers and demographic segments. Each record connects one customer with one demographic type.

Data.Title: <%%>ScDemo.Northwind.CustomerDemographic._EntityName
Data.EntityComment: Stores customer demographic categories used to classify customers. These demographic definitions are shared across customers through an association table. The records are relatively static and represent reusable classification values.

Data.Title: <%%>ScDemo.Northwind.Employee._EntityName
Data.EntityComment: Stores employee records including personal details, contact information, and employment dates. Employees can report to another employee through a hierarchical relationship. They may also be assigned to orders and territories.

Data.Title: <%%>ScDemo.Northwind.EmployeeTerritory._EntityName
Data.EntityComment: Associative entity that maps employees to territories. It is used to represent the many-to-many relationship between employees and the regions they serve. Each record connects one employee with one territory.

Data.Title: <%%>ScDemo.Northwind.Order._EntityName
Data.EntityComment: Stores customer orders including dates, freight, and shipping information. Orders are optionally linked to a customer, an employee, and a shipper. This entity represents the order header.

Data.Title: <%%>ScDemo.Northwind.OrderDetail._EntityName
Data.EntityComment: Stores the line items for customer orders, including quantity, unit price, and discount. Each record belongs to one order and one product. This entity captures the products included in each order.

Data.Title: <%%>ScDemo.Northwind.Product._EntityName
Data.EntityComment: Stores product master data including pricing, stock levels, and discontinuation status. Each product may be linked to a category and a supplier. This entity represents items available for ordering.

Data.Title: <%%>ScDemo.Northwind.Region._EntityName
Data.EntityComment: Stores geographic regions used to organize territories. Regions act as a parent classification for territories. This entity is a compact reference table.

Data.Title: <%%>ScDemo.Northwind.Shipper._EntityName
Data.EntityComment: Stores shipping companies used for order delivery. These records are referenced by orders to indicate the carrier. The entity represents external logistics providers.

Data.Title: <%%>ScDemo.Northwind.Supplier._EntityName
Data.EntityComment: Stores supplier master data including company and contact information. Suppliers provide products and may have optional address and communication details. This entity represents vendors in the supply chain.

Data.Title: <%%>ScDemo.Northwind.Territory._EntityName
Data.EntityComment: Stores sales territories and their descriptions. Each territory belongs to a single region. Employees can be assigned to territories through a linking entity.
